Chapter 6348: Myriad Immortal Remedy

Chapter 6348: Myriad Immortal Remedy

Silence Peak turned into a runic chapter spewing worldly energy and dao power. However, they remained in the vicinity instead of spreading outward.

The rotating chapter absorbed the various powers. Meanwhile, the divine plants also released their dao essences and medicinal fragrances.

Thus, various divinities and lights manifested all around Silence Peak. The essences became immensely thick.

The coral forests spewed out refreshing liquid full of life just like ocean water, forming gurgling streams.

The nine-sun vine spewed out its unique solar flames. Instead of incinerating, they flowed gently together with other dao powers.

The great bamboo tree released its green light, overshadowing everything else. It looked like a green rain from a distance. As it washed the other dao essences, they formed tiny veins in the sky to facilitate various flows.

The hundred-dao tea tree fluttered and released dao hymns, harmonizing with everything else. It sounded like spirits singing and dancing, increasing the speed of the essences.

The same thing happened with the other divine plants. This exceeded everyone’s imagination - the transformation of Silence Peak into a paradise for cultivation.

The worldly essences and dao powers became purer and full of life after being augmented by the plants. The forces here could heal everything or give birth to a new life.

Calling this place a supreme land of alchemy was not unreasonable. However, Li Qiye raised his hand again.

“Boom!” The lakes within Desolate Frontier appeared before everyone.

“Unity Nine Lakes!” Everyone observed the lakes in astonishment.

Of course, there were only eight lakes since the first was a legend. They tilted and poured down the essences hidden at the bottom. It changed all of Silence Peak and modified the evolving worldly energy.

Finally, three things merged into a dark green pool - the vast worldly energy, the medicinal powers of the plants, and the essences of the lakes.

Spectators didn’t know what the pool was but its life force level was unprecedented. Once the pool was refined to the limit, the essences within started maturing and forming a green tree. It forced everyone to look up into the air as it grew larger.

In actuality, Silence Peak was not particularly tall, neither was this tree. It was only the size of a man and had twelve branches. The whole thing looked like a piece of emerald jade. It looked natural like the work of the high heaven, not sculpted by men.

Each branch only had a single leaf growing on it, nothing else. Nevertheless, the leaves looked like twelve worlds due to their unimaginable life force. It gave the impression of being a world tree capable of gestating countless lives.

Its magnificent nature trumped its humble stature, making everyone look up and see twelve hanging worlds.

“Boom!” The lakes returned to their position and Silence Peak stopped releasing worldly energy. The divine plants also entered a resting state.

This new tree looked to be the greatest in Desolate Frontier, looming over the rest. It was connected to all the earth veins and their worldly energy.

“Ancestor, what is this tree?” Absolute Ancestor asked, aware that it would be very beneficial to Desolate Frontier.

“No name yet.” Li Qiye smiled and said: “Let’s call it myriad immortal remedy then.”

“Myriad immortal remedy tree.” The others repeated. Although unaware of the tree’s effects, just the name alone shocked them.

“Okay, you all helped out with the tree, so rewards are necessary. The spoil can’t belong to Silence Peak alone.” Li Qiye clapped and smiled.

“Rewards?” Alch-deer became curious.

“Each of you shall get a leaf.” Li Qiye said.

“A leaf.” The group looked up and saw the world-like leaves, knowing just how unique they were.
